title: A Bad Novice Monk
html:

  • 2. Dutiyavagga Chapter Two

Pāpasāmaṇerasutta A Bad Novice Monk

“Addasaṁ sāmaṇeraṁ vehāsaṁ gacchantaṁ. “I saw a novice monk flying through the air. Tassa saṅghāṭipi ādittā …pe… His outer robe was burning …” …

pāpasāmaṇero ahosi …pe…. “He used to be a bad novice monk …”

Dasamaṁ.
